title: Land cover · 30 m source
source: USGS Annual NLCD Collection 1.2, served by MRLC
attribution: USGS Annual NLCD 2025 · MRLC · 30 m source

classes.label: Open water
classes.description: Open-water land cover; no depth, current, seasonal stage, or drinking-water quality is inferred.

classes.label: Perennial ice/snow
classes.description: Persistent ice/snow land cover; this is not November snowfall or seasonal snow depth.

classes.label: Developed, open space
classes.description: Mostly vegetation within developed settings; no individual building or road geometry.

classes.label: Developed, low intensity
classes.description: A mixture of development and vegetation; no individual building or road geometry.

classes.label: Developed, medium intensity
classes.description: A greater proportion of developed surface; no individual building or road geometry.

classes.label: Developed, high intensity
classes.description: Predominantly developed surface; no individual building or road geometry.

classes.label: Barren land (rock/sand/clay)
classes.description: Sparse vegetation over exposed rock or other earth materials; no soil-bearing strength is inferred.

classes.label: Deciduous forest
classes.description: Forest dominated by seasonally leaf-shedding trees; trunk spacing and understory are not measured here.

classes.label: Evergreen forest
classes.description: Forest dominated by evergreen trees; trunk spacing and understory are not measured here.

classes.label: Mixed forest
classes.description: Forest containing both deciduous and evergreen trees; trunk spacing and understory are not measured here.

classes.label: Shrub/scrub
classes.description: Shrub vegetation, including some young or stunted trees; local stem density is unknown.

classes.label: Grassland/herbaceous
classes.description: Predominantly grasses and other non-woody vegetation; November height and ground condition are unknown.

classes.label: Pasture/hay
classes.description: Managed forage vegetation; harvest, mowing, grazing, and November surface condition are unknown.

classes.label: Cultivated crops
classes.description: Cultivated land, including some orchards and vineyards; November harvest and tillage status are unknown.

classes.label: Woody wetlands
classes.description: Woody vegetation associated with periodic saturation or inundation; current wetness and depth are unknown.

classes.label: Emergent herbaceous wetlands
classes.description: Non-woody wetland vegetation associated with periodic saturation or inundation; current wetness and depth are unknown.
